name: Finding Useful Tamable Allies
source: Running away from her old crew, MC finds herself in a new and unknown city with no friends and not a single penny to her name. Her future uncertain, she decides to prepare for eventual confrontation. If she’s going to fight back, she might as well do it properly. It’s time to explore the city, tame befriend some useful allies cute girls, build her own power, and destroy those who wronged her!
translation: 逃离昔日团伙后，女主角孤身流落到一座陌生的城市，既无朋友，也身无分文。面对前途未卜的未来，她决定为迟早到来的正面对决提前做好准备。既然迟早要反击，那就干脆干得漂亮一点。是时候探索这座城市，驯服——或者说结交——一些得力的盟友兼可爱女孩，壮大属于自己的势力，彻底粉碎那些曾辜负她的人！
